name: Half-Life: Opposing Force
description: Half-Life: Opposing Force is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter expansion in the Half-Life series.

eax.problem: The original release used DirectSound3D, but a 2013 update replaced it with a newer audio engine that dropped EAX entirely.
eax.fix: If you still have the original pre-2013 retail/CD release installed outside Steam, its EAX calls are intact and this script restores EAX normally there.
